result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best accounting software for a small business depends on how you operate, but if you're running a small business in the UK, I'd shortlist **Xero, QuickBooks, FreeAgent and Sage**\.

My initial recommendation would be **Xero for an established small business** and **FreeAgent for a freelancer or sole trader**\.

Here's how I'd compare them.

## Best accounting software compared

| Software | Best for | Main advantage |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Xero | Growing small businesses | Excellent integrations and reporting |
| QuickBooks | General small business accounting | Easy invoicing and bank reconciliation |
| FreeAgent | Sole traders and freelancers | Excellent UK tax features |
| Sage | Businesses with payroll | Strong UK accounting and payroll options |
| Zoho Books | Budget-conscious businesses | Good value and automation |


### My top three

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero — Best overall**

(My overall recommendation)

- Excellent bank reconciliation.
- VAT returns and financial reporting.
- Lots of integrations.
- Suitable as your business grows.

Particularly good for limited companies with employees or multiple users.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks — Best for ease of use**

- Straightforward bookkeeping.
- Good mobile app.
- Invoicing and expense management.
- Useful financial reports.

A good choice if you want to manage your finances yourself.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![FreeAgent Review: Features, Pricing, Pros & Cons](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/AWrYG5UElICV_2QqNniGBOJg-DuJb7bzMDkMbcm700h1nQnWQTJ-0M80r1lnMU0oD2rFCgi2YvXIZB2Umi8wczyWPQfft3pogJ8F48-Lsaw-bXn26n8ROlYeIROX9k57q9T8hKC5ow8yJaZsxkoZIQjbRlS28cXXnAUhnN7Xx_NmwItPbM1G2HrfhOQcoZLf?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. FreeAgent — Best for sole traders**

- Designed around UK tax requirements.
- Self Assessment support.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Can be free with certain qualifying bank accounts.

Particularly attractive for freelancers and contractors.

[FreeAgent website](https://www.freeagent.com/)

These recommendations reflect UK software comparisons published in 2026. Before choosing, I'd like to narrow it down because the best software for a one-person business can be very different from that for a company with employees.
